compound.order: gain then read-noise then floor; final clipping[0,1]

stage0.intensity_units: existing float32 fixed-[L,U] normalized crop x in[0,1]; sigma measured in units of U-L, eta in corresponding normalized intensity units
stage0.normalization_order: published image -> existing fixed normalization/clipping -> synthetic transform; no adaptive renormalization after transform
stage0.scope: crop-level proxy; overlapping crops may have independent deterministic noise, not whole-slide physical simulation
stage0.denominator: finite valid pixels of labelled target instance masks; excludes padding and noninstance background; not all tissue pixels
stage0.zero_threshold: perWSI full target-pixel quantile; ties and pre-existing zeros mean achieved fraction may exceed target; report actual fractions
stage0.boundary_validity: reuse raw ROI valid support for rare partial-context crops; no noise added outside valid support
stage0.runtime_gate: conservative scaled timing estimate must leave at least25% of remaining8h for later stages; otherwise stop and report instead of silently subsampling
stage0.noise_interpretation: Gaussian heteroscedastic shot-noise approximation plus Gaussian read noise; not calibrated photon counts or exact Poisson draw

zero_label.selection: leave-one-internal-source-WSI-out, all perturbations grouped; no external selection
zero_label.dev_gate: no clean F1 degradation; AP loss no worse than.003; actual dev FPR reported, target1% not assumed
zero_label.core_adaptation: own unlabelled input only; full development fit may transfer global learned reference
zero_label.spatial_candidate_definition: within-unit target nonzero-rate<=own20th percentile and neighbor normalized mean<=own50th percentile, observed neighbor area>0; no biological-negative guarantee
zero_label.reference: equal-weight median of eligible source-WSI candidate logit95th percentiles; candidate count shrinkage n/(n+200)
zero_label.mixture_acceptance: nonzero target;>=200 rows; converged; both weights>=.05; mean separation>=pooledSD; lower-mean component mean+2.326347874SD; any failed reference or own-unit fit=>identity
proxy_features: median/p95 of per-cell positive-pixel mean among nonzero cells
zero_label.proxy_population: labelled cohort treated as unlabelled; not all tissue instances; equal cell weights
zero_label.ridge_fit: each heldout internal WSI plus all its derived perturbations excluded from scaling/fitting; train clean and moderate scenarios on other2WSIs; target own-source clean vs perturbed negative99th-percentile logit difference; prediction clamp[-2,2]
zero_label.development_gate: for each3seed and ENS, clean pooledF1 not below baseline and any scenario pooledAP loss<=.003, no external evaluation if failed
zero_label.external_evaluation: only development-passed candidates; original frozen all-internal threshold; all42cores own-unit unlabelled summaries; no external reselection

active.topK_rule: closest native logit to frozen threshold, tie hash
active.estimator: regularized intercept, b^2/2 penalty, one-class fallback toglobal, no importance weights
active.sampling_bias: deterministic boundary-selection assumptions explicitly reported; no unjustified population-unbiased claim
